goals.goal: A user opens the static site, drops a text-based single-column PDF, and downloads an EPUB that passes epubcheck 5.3 with 0 errors (Kindle acceptance itself is unverified; epubcheck is the proxy)
The EPUB reads as reflowable prose: running headers/footers and page numbers removed, hyphenated line breaks rejoined, paragraphs not split at page breaks, and the book split into chapters
The PDF stays on the device: during conversion the app makes no cross-origin requests and sends no request bodies
Encrypted, scanned (no text layer), undecodable and non-PDF inputs produce a specific error message instead of an EPUB

items.title: EPUB 3 writer from a book model
acceptance: writeEpub({title, author, chapters[3]}) → zip whose first entry is 'mimetype', stored uncompressed, content 'application/epub+zip'
that EPUB → epubcheck 5.3 (epubcheck-static) reports 0 errors, 0 fatals
paragraph text containing & < > " → escaped in XHTML; epubcheck still 0 errors
title 'Truyện Kiều' → appears unchanged in content.opf dc:title and nav.xhtml
nav.xhtml lists one entry per chapter, in order, with the chapter titles
book with 0 chapters → error 'book has no content', no zip produced

goal-1: test/review-fixes.test.ts: strips characters illegal in XML 1.0

items.title: Layout: pdf.js text items → lines → paragraphs
acceptance: items with str '' or height 0 → ignored (probed: pdf.js 6.5 emits these before every drawText)
items whose baselines differ by ≤ 0.5 × font size → joined into one line, ordered by x
consecutive lines 14pt apart at 11pt size → same paragraph; a gap ≥ 1.5 × the page's median line spacing → new paragraph (heuristic constant, named in code)
line indented ≥ 1 × font size relative to the block's left edge → starts a new paragraph
page with two x-clusters of lines (two columns) → all left-column lines come before right-column lines

items.title: Cleanup: headers/footers, page numbers, hyphenation, page-break merge, Unicode
acceptance: line with the same text at the same y (±2pt) on > 50% of pages (threshold from design.md) → removed from every page
line in the top or bottom 10% of the page whose text is only a number or roman numeral → removed
'exam-' at line end + 'ple' → 'example'; 'Jean-' + 'Paul' (next starts uppercase) → 'Jean-Paul'
last paragraph of a page not ending in . ! ? … " ” ) and next page starting lowercase → merged into one paragraph
decomposed 'Vie\u0302\u0323t' → NFC 'Việt'; ligatures 'ﬁ' 'ﬂ' → 'fi' 'fl'

items.title: Structure: headings, chapters, metadata
acceptance: body size = most common line height weighted by character count; a paragraph of ≤ 15 words with height ≥ 1.3 × body size → heading (probed: pdf.js item height = font size; fontName is the same id across sizes, so size is used, not font name)
PDF with a top-level outline of 3 entries → 3 chapters split at those entries' pages, titled by the outline
PDF without outline (probed: pdf-lib output returns null) → chapters split at headings of the largest heading size
no outline and no headings → 1 chapter titled with the book title
metadata Title present → used as title; absent → filename without '.pdf'; Author absent → 'Unknown'

goal-2: test/review-fixes.test.ts: F-4 through a real PDF

items.title: Unconvertible input detection
acceptance: password-protected PDF → error 'This PDF is password-protected' (probed: pdf.js throws PasswordException code 1 on a pypdf-encrypted fixture)
PDF where every page has 0 non-empty text items → error 'This looks like a scanned PDF with no text layer'
extracted text with > 10% of characters in U+FFFD, private-use or control ranges → error 'Text in this PDF could not be decoded' (unverified: 10% threshold is a guess, no measurement behind it)
bytes that are not a PDF → error 'Not a valid PDF file'

goal-4: test/review-fixes.test.ts: goal-4 end to end through convert()

items.title: End-to-end convert() pipeline
acceptance: convert(bytes of a generated 30-page fixture: running header, page numbers, 3 chapter headings, a hyphenated line break, a paragraph crossing a page break) → EPUB with 0 epubcheck errors
that EPUB → nav has 3 chapters; no XHTML contains the running header text or a bare page number paragraph; 'example' is present and 'exam-' is not; the cross-page paragraph is one
onProgress is called once per page with (page, total); the last call is (30, 30)
encrypted fixture → convert rejects with the F-5 password error

goal-1: test/convert.test.ts: produces an EPUB with 0 epubcheck errors
goal-2: test/convert.test.ts: headers, page numbers, hyphenation, cross-page, 3 chapters

items.title: Static web UI: drop, progress, download, errors
acceptance: on the built site (vite preview), choosing the 30-page fixture → progress text updates and a download link '<title>.epub' appears; the downloaded file passes epubcheck with 0 errors
during that conversion → Playwright records 0 requests to another origin and 0 requests with a body (POST/PUT/PATCH)
choosing the encrypted fixture → the password error message is shown and no download link appears
conversion runs in a Web Worker: the progress text changes at least twice before the download link appears
output larger than 50 MB → warning 'Over Send-to-Kindle email limit (50 MB); use the web or app upload' (unverified: Amazon's limit taken from their docs, not probed)
